description: This file defines the abstract class 'Image_Graph_Common' which provides common functionality for graph-related classes in the Image_Graph package. It includes methods for managing parent-child relationships, rendering, error handling, and element management within the graph creation framework.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Common
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared functionality for all Image_Graph classes, including element management, rendering, and parent relations.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets child elements and their states.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent object and propagates to child elements.

methods.name: _getCanvas
methods.description: Retrieves the canvas object associated with this graph.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an existing element to the elements list.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Creates and adds a new element of specified class to the elements list.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Displays an error message on the canvas.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes rendering and outputs to the canvas.
